subCategories.label: Cheesy
playerOptions: Are you redstone, {npc}? You power my day.
I burned bread again. The wheat was offended.

npcResponses: You got a laugh out of me. Don't let it go to your head.
Oh {player}, that was terrible. ...I loved it.

subCategories.label: Dark
playerOptions: At least only my plans exploded today.
The void might start charging me rent.

npcResponses: Let's keep jokes lighter. {village} has enough problems.
Hah! Now that's my kind of humor.
Dark... but honest. I respect that, {player}.

subCategories.label: Self-Deprecating
playerOptions: I got lost in my own house again.
I missed a zombie with a bow at point-blank range.

npcResponses: We've all had days like that, {player}.
At least you can laugh about it. That takes courage.

subCategories.label: Meta
playerOptions: Feels like someone is clicking our dialogue options.
Do you ever feel like this world is code, {npc}?

npcResponses: You think too much, but I like it.
Sometimes I feel like my whole life follows a script. Weird, right?
